topic: Understand What It Means to Invest
source_evidence: You could lose your “principal,” which is the amount you’ve invested.
answer: Principal is the amount of money you put into an investment. When you invest in securities, mutual funds, or similar products, you can lose some or all of that principal because these investments are not federally insured like FDIC-insured deposits. Buying an investment through a bank does not remove this risk.
